If Vital Seamless Leggings don’t work out, you’ve got a couple of options. 😊
You can return them within 30 days of delivery (as long as they’re unworn and unwashed). Underwear and swimwear can’t be returned for hygiene reasons, and socks can only be returned if they’re still sealed in the original packaging.
If you’re in France, you can also return or exchange items in our retail stores in the country you purchased from (just bring your order number). If you want to exchange, it’s for a different size of the same item, and the new size won’t ship until your return is scanned in at our warehouse.
To start a return or exchange, use our Returns Portal and follow the prompts (you’ll choose items, reason, and drop off method). 💙
